items.prompt: White has just played Rh1. It is Black's turn. Which reply would White have to be most ready for? Choose Black's strongest move.

claims.statement: Qxh1 is the engine's best reply at depth 16.
The next-best looking reply c5c2 is at least 3 pawns worse for Black.

hints: Before looking for your own idea, list every check and capture the opponent has.
Which of those replies changes the material count most?
One reply takes something that was left on a square the opponent attacks.
items.explain: The engine at depth 16 rates Qxh1 as Black's strongest reply, and a clearly weaker alternative exists. Predicting the reply before you commit is the habit this question tests.
